payload.blocks: Phase 1 and so the plan's done status; nothing else.
payload.headline: Land of live-run phase 1 refused: cargo is not on the lead session's PATH

parts.cause: The land's regenerate step compiles the git addon with cargo; in the lead session it fails with spawnSync cargo ENOENT, so cargo is not on its PATH. Log: .fgos/runtime/land/land-2079456-1795098730356931368-1.log.

options.cost: One session environment fix by the owner or supervisor.
options.does: Restart or reconfigure this lead session so the cargo toolchain is on its PATH, then the lead lands again.
options.gain: The live run proceeds as designed with nobody typing a command in the plan.
options.label: Put cargo on PATH

options.does: The owner runs fgos land supervisor-live-run/p01 from a shell that has cargo.
options.harm: The live run is no longer hands-off, so it proves less about the supervisor.
options.label: Owner lands the branch

parts.recommendation: Put cargo on the lead session's PATH: it keeps the live run's purpose (no human typing a command) intact and the lead retries the same land.

scope.allows: Changing the lead session's environment so land can compile the addon.
scope.forbids: Editing the land door, hand-running its regenerate scripts, or touching anything outside plans/261119-1142-supervisor-live-run.

parts.what: Phase 1's branch supervisor-live-run/p01 holds the finished, in-footprint scratch file (unit run passed, diff reviewed). fgos land refused with land-regenerate-failed, so the phase is not landed and the plan stays running.
